scope: Local exact namesake follow-up, 2 April–1 May 2027 inclusive, LV/LT/EE. Existing name-origin evidence and uncertainty labels are preserved; this does not verify name histories.

people.method: Reconciled every under-five profile with complete cached national exact-title discovery and country/prominence outcomes from rounds 117–125. No broad Wikipedia or Wikidata query was repeated. Searched the shared private cache for 62 selected name strings, then followed targeted professional/institutional biographies. Every accepted page was fetched with the official source-cache tool and its extracted text inspected for exact spelling, role and country association. Source URLs remain research/provenance only.
